title: Field Oriented Control Autotuner
text: Automatically and sequentially tune multiple PID control loops in field-oriented control application, 13 inputs, 10 outputs, {Type} sets Flux loop; {Tune D-axis current loop} enables d-axis current loop tuning, {Tune Q-axis current loop} enables q-axis current loop tuning, {Tune speed loop} enables speed loop tuning, {Tune flux loop} enables flux loop tuning, {Use same settings for current loop controllers (D-axis + Q-axis)} enables same tuning and experiment settings for direct-axis and quadrature-axis current, {Use same settings for outer loop controllers (Speed + Flux)} enables same tuning and experiment settings for speed and flux, {Experiment sample time} sets the sample time of frequency response estimation experiment, {Use different sample time for tuning} enables tuning at different sample time from loop PID controller, {Tuning sample time (sec)} sets the sample time of tuning algorithm, {Form} sets the d-axis current loop PID controller form, {Controller sample time (sec)} sets the d-axis current loop PID controller sample, {Integrator method} sets the d-axis current loop controller discrete integration formula for integrator term Forward, {Filter method} sets the d-axis current loop controller discrete integration formula for derivative filter term Forward, {Target bandwidth (rad/sec)} sets the d-axis current loop target crossover frequency of tuned, {Target phase margin (degrees)} sets the d-axis current loop target minimum phase, {D-axis current loop start time (sec)} sets the direct-axis current loop tuning experiment start, {D-axis current loop experiment duration (sec)} sets the direct-axis current loop tuning experiment, {Q-axis current loop start time (sec)} sets the quadrature-axis current loop tuning experiment start, {Q-axis current loop experiment duration (sec)} sets the quadrature-axis current loop tuning experiment, {Speed loop start time (sec)} sets the speed loop tuning experiment start time, {Speed loop experiment duration (sec)} sets the speed loop tuning experiment duration, {Flux loop start time (sec)} sets the flux loop tuning experiment start time, {Flux loop experiment duration (sec)} sets the flux loop tuning experiment duration, {Experiment Mode} sets the sinusoidal perturbation signal type, {Plant Type} sets the stability of direct-axis current plant, {Plant Sign} sets the sign of direct-axis current, {Sine Amplitudes} sets the amplitude of sinusoidal perturbations in direct-axis current, {Use external source for bandwidths} sets the supply external signal for target, {Use external source for target phase margins} sets the supply external signal for target phase, {Use external source for start/stops of experiment} sets the supply external signal for start and stop of tuning, {Use external source for sine amplitudes} sets the supply external signal for sinusoidal perturbation, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Estimated phase margin achieved by tuned controllers} sets the phase margin achieved by most recently tuned, {Plant frequency responses near bandwidth} sets the estimated frequency response for most recently tuned, {Plant nominal input and output} sets the plant input and output at nominal operating, {Start/stop of autotuning process} sets the signal indicating start and end of experiment for each tuned and {Export to MATLAB} sets the send experiment and tuning results to MATLAB workspace. Values come from the instance.
